evidence: Dream triggers post-wave or on /dream command. Logs behavioral evidence to .wabblespec/memory/dream-log.json (10 runs logged through Phase 4). Maintains .wabblespec/memory/gap-map.md with identified framework gaps and their priority/status. Theater test (from Phase 4): simulates Dream output without modifying .wabblespec/ — validates the module can produce correct gap-map entries against known inputs. Behavioral change evidence from run #1 confirmed the gap-map format. Dream is scheduled by Autopilot after significant waves. Gap entries include: topic, current_state, future_option, priority (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), source. Dream reads receipt corpus to identify recurring patterns before L8 Instinct runs.
